questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What open public wifi exposes

stimulus.body: A traveller uses open wifi in an airport to read the news. The network has no password.

questions.stem: What does open public wifi mainly expose?

options.text: It exposes only your device's colour.
It exposes your traffic to others on the network.
It exposes nothing if you are quick.
It exposes only the airport's schedule.

questions.explanation: Open wifi exposes traffic. B trivialises, C confuses speed with safety, and D confuses network with airport.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What a privacy setting actually changes
questions.learningObjective: Explain what a privacy setting changes
questions.stem: A user sets a post to friends only. What does that actually change?

options.text: It makes the post invisible to the platform.
It deletes the post after a week.
It limits who can see the post.

questions.explanation: Friends only limits visibility. B confuses with deletion, C with invisibility to the platform, and D with connectivity.
